body:
This was my first time trying this. And I figured I'd do it right. Snorting heroin is a waste and turns into morphine in my system, giving me a familiar sensation. Shooting heroin however, well, it's quite different.
Earlier that night my friend and I had acquired some chocolates. Mushrooms aren't really my favorite. I prefer strong acid, 2c-e, etc. Mushrooms don't really do it for me, and if they were too, I'd have to eat a lot and spend the night dry heaving.
Anyway, we ate 2 grams of these. Two hours into it, we went outside. We were tripping with 3 other people who'd decided not to venture outdoors. Everyone else was tripping. I had no hallucinations. I had a body buzz and my heart rate was definitely up. Earlier that night my friend had gotten two bags of H and needles. I'd told myself I wasn't going to do it, just because when I first did it, I wanted to experience it by itself.
We ended up in our friend's car out front. My friend had already shot some, and she was going to do more. She needed my assistance, so my presence was necessary.
After I saw her reaction from the combination of both drugs, I decided I wanted to do it also. Our other buddy came out and sat in the car with us. We filled it up, and I did it myself.
I felt it instantly. First sick. I turned and opened the car door because I thought I might finally throw up (I'd been trying to all night because the shrooms were making me feel funny). The last thing I remember is putting my feet on the ground outside of the car, and feeling tired?
I had a wonderful dream. A dream of a dream where I knew I was dreaming but I had forgotten how I'd gotten to that state.
I woke up. My eyes were watering. I woke up to my guy friend that had just sat down with us. He was yelling my name and slapping my face. My gum was still in my mouth along with a bit of something else, but I wasn't sure what.
I sat up and dried my eyes. I stepped out of the car and laid on the cool concrete of their drive way. My other friend had run back out. I needed water. I felt wonderful. I didn't question what had just happened, but I was confused.
Apparently I'd passed out. Just fell back. The small bit of whatever that was in my mouth, I believe, was a bit of my tongue, because a small small section on the side was bleeding.
The rest of the night was fine. I slept better than I ever have in my life.
Would I do it again? Probably. Not with shrooms or anything with the ability to increase my heart rate.
